deye_sg04lp3.yaml_template:
# ==============================================================================
# Home Assistant Hardware Integration Pack generated by pl-hems-mpc
# Target Inverter : Deye SUN-8/10/12K-SG04LP3-EU (3-Phase Low-Voltage Hybrid)
# Protocol Note   : Modbus TCP via Waveshare RS485-ETH (BMS/Modbus port) or Solarman V5 stick (port 8899)
# ==============================================================================
modbus:
  - name: deye_sg04lp3_hub
    type: tcp
    host: 192.168.1.50
    port: 502
    sensors:
      - name: "DEYE_SG04LP3 Battery SoC"
        unit_of_measurement: "%"
        slave: 1
        address: 166
        data_type: uint16
        scan_interval: 15
      - name: "DEYE_SG04LP3 Grid PCC Active Power"
        unit_of_measurement: "W"
        slave: 1
        address: 172
        data_type: uint16
        device_class: power
        scan_interval: 10

automation:
  - id: pl_hems_mpc_deye_sg04lp3_dispatch
    alias: "PL-HEMS 15-min Dispatch (Deye SUN-8/10/12K-SG04LP3-EU (3-Phase Low-Voltage Hybrid) + SG Ready + OCPP)"
    trigger:
      - platform: time_pattern
        minutes: "/15"
    action:
      # 1. Write MPC Battery / Export Setpoint to DEYE_SG04LP3 (Reg 142: Time-of-Use bitmask (Bit 0=Enable, Bits 1..6=Days))
      - service: modbus.write_register
        data:
          hub: deye_sg04lp3_hub
          unit: 1
          address: 142
          value: "{{ states('sensor.pl_hems_mpc_bess_setpoint_w') | int(0) }}"
      # 2. Drive Heat Pump SG Ready Relay 1 & 2 (Boost when RCE <= 0 or cheap ToU window)
      - service: switch.turn_{{ 'on' if is_state('binary_sensor.pl_hems_sg_ready_boost', 'on') else 'off' }}
        target:
          entity_id: switch.heat_pump_sg_ready_relay_2
      # 3. Modulate OCPP 1.6J Wallbox Current (0 A or 6..16 A 3-phase)
      - service: number.set_value
        target:
          entity_id: number.wallbox_ocpp_max_current
        data:
          value: "{{ states('sensor.pl_hems_ocpp_ev_current_a') | int(0) }}"
